Runner Disqualified from Berlin Marathon for Riding Bicycle

Chinese runner Sun Yuanyuan was disqualified from the Berlin Marathon after completing a portion of the race on a bicycle. The incident went viral on social media, with Yuanyuan being described as a fitness influencer. The Berlin Marathon authorities disqualified the participant following the unusual act.
